meta.title: Moolam
meta.description: A passport for every AI generated image, registered on Monad the moment it is made and verifiable from any re-encoded copy.

common.swapNotice: Placeholder art. The real still lands with the hero build.

home.title: Every generated image carries its own record.
home.lede: Moolam writes the exact bytes and two perceptual fingerprints of an image into a passport at the moment it is made, so any copy of it can be traced back to the creator and the agent that made it.

story.title: Moolam
story.noWebgl: This browser could not open a 3D context, so the story is here as a page. Every figure on it is the same live read.

made.title: An AI made this one.
made.body: Agent {agent} signed the fingerprint inside its own enclave before anybody had seen the picture.

sealed.title: The creator's passkey signed it.
sealed.body: Monad recorded it in block {block}. Two signatures, one record, about a second.
sealed.bodyNoBlock: Monad recorded it. Two signatures, one record, about a second.
sealed.unread: This passport could not be read from the registry.

shared.title: Platforms strip the credential on upload.
shared.body: The copies keep travelling anyway: recompressed, shrunk to a tenth, turned, mirrored, run through a social pipeline. Every one of them has lost the file that said where it came from.

verified.title: Every copy still finds its record.
verified.attestation: Chainlink re-checked it and wrote the answer on chain: {result}, {distance} bits apart.
verified.attestationOther: Chainlink re-checked passport {passport} in this registry and wrote the answer on chain: {result}, {distance} bits apart.
verified.noAttestation: No independent re-check has been written for this passport yet.
verified.provenance: Figures measured by the Moolam verifier on passport {passport}, {date}.

trusted.title: Trust an agent earns image by image.
trusted.counts: {verifications, plural, =1 {# verification} other {# verifications}}, {passports, plural, =1 {# passport} other {# passports}}
trusted.body: Every check the verifier runs is written back to the ERC-8004 reputation registry under this agent's own id. Its standing is the sum of its work, not a claim on a website.

tryIt.title: Drop any copy of any image.
tryIt.hint: JPEG or PNG. It goes to the Moolam verifier, is fingerprinted three ways, and is not stored.
tryIt.offline: The verifier service is not answering. Start it with npm run dev:verifier from the repo root, then drop the file again.
tryIt.noMatchBody: No passport in the registry matches this image. A file straight out of a generator that was never registered looks exactly like this.
tryIt.noManifest: No C2PA manifest left in this file. The record found it anyway.

close.title: Register once. Recognised anywhere.
close.body: A passport for every generated image, written on Monad the moment it is made, re-checked by Chainlink, and findable from any copy that survives the internet.
close.error: The index could not be read: {reason}

verify.title: Verify an image
verify.lede: Upload any copy. Moolam fingerprints it three ways and searches every registered passport, so a resized or re-encoded file still finds its record.
verify.hint: JPEG or PNG, up to 20 MB. The file goes to the Moolam verifier and is not stored.
verify.pending: Fingerprinting the image and searching the registry.
verify.noneHint: Cropped copies do not match yet. Try the file as it came out of the generator.
verify.manifestMissing: No C2PA manifest left in this file
verify.offline: The verifier service is not answering. Start it with npm run dev:verifier from the repo root, then try again.

passport.notFound: No passport with that id. Check the id, or find it from the verify page.
passport.error: The registry could not be read: {reason}. Reload the page.
passport.creator: Creator

attestations.heading: Verifications
attestations.empty: No verification has been written for this passport yet. The Chainlink workflow adds one when it re-checks the image.

children.heading: Edits
children.empty: No edit has been registered from this passport.

agent.title: Agent
agent.notFound: No agent with that id on the ERC-8004 identity registry.
agent.error: The identity registry could not be read: {reason}. Reload the page.
agent.cardMissing: The agent card could not be read from its URI.

reputation.heading: Reputation
reputation.empty: No feedback recorded for this agent yet. The verifier writes one after every check it runs.
reputation.error: The reputation registry could not be read: {reason}.

studio.title: Register an image
studio.lede: Sign in, unlock with this device once, then every image you make gets its own record on Monad: fingerprinted, signed by you, and findable from any copy that survives the internet.
studio.noWallet: You are signed in, but no account was created on Monad yet. Reload the page, or sign out and sign in again.
studio.notConfigured: Privy is not configured, so nobody can sign in here. Put NEXT_PUBLIC_PRIVY_APP_ID in packages/web/.env.local and restart the dev server.

identity.gasProven: Paid by Moolam. Your balance did not move.
identity.kindPasskey: a passkey, with no email on file

signedOut.heading: Sign in and an account is made for you
signedOut.body: There is no wallet to install and no seed phrase to write down. Sign in with your email, your Google account or a passkey, and Privy creates an account on Monad in your name.
signedOut.button: Sign in and create my account
signedOut.methods: Email, Google or a passkey. Whichever you choose, the account is yours.

wallet.label: Your account
wallet.body: Made the moment you sign in, held by Privy, and nobody at Moolam can sign with it.

passkey.label: Your signature
passkey.body: The fingerprint or face unlock on this device signs each image. It never leaves the device.

gas.label: The network fee
gas.body: Moolam pays it through Privy, so registering an image costs you nothing.

passkey.reading: Checking whether this account already has a passkey
passkey.unreadable: Monad could not be read, so this page does not know whether your account has a passkey yet: {reason}. Reload the page.

bind.heading: Link this device to your account
bind.body: Your account has no signature on it yet. Bind the unlock on this device once and it becomes the signature on every image you register.
bind.plain: A passkey is the fingerprint, face unlock or PIN this device already uses. It stays on the device: Moolam only ever sees the public half.
bind.creating: Making a passkey on this device
bind.waiting: Waiting for your fingerprint or face unlock
bind.sending: Sending it to Monad, network fee sponsored
bind.doneBody: This device now signs for your account. Register an image and it will ask for your unlock once.

recover.heading: Your passkey was set up somewhere else
recover.body: Monad says this account already has a passkey, and this browser has never used it. Unlock with that passkey here and you can carry on, or bind this device instead.
recover.waiting: Waiting for your fingerprint or face unlock
recover.otherDevice: If that passkey lives on your phone or another laptop, open Moolam there, or bind this device instead. Binding replaces the old one and costs one transaction.

register.heading: Give an image its passport
register.body: One picture at a time. It is fingerprinted and pinned, you sign it with your unlock, and Moolam sends it to Monad.
register.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 20 MB. Moolam embeds a C2PA manifest, fingerprints the signed bytes and pins the file to IPFS.
register.title: Title
register.titleHint: It goes into the manifest and the metadata, so keep it the name you would call the picture.

prepare.waiting: Fingerprint and pin the file, about ten seconds
prepare.running: Fingerprinting and pinning, about ten seconds
prepare.done: Fingerprinted, manifest embedded, pinned to IPFS

sign.running: Waiting for your fingerprint or face unlock

send.waiting: Send it to Monad, network fee sponsored
send.running: Sending to Monad, network fee sponsored

register.doneHeading: This image now has a passport
register.doneBody: Any copy of it, resized, re-encoded or turned sideways, can be traced back to this record from the verify page.

receipt.heading: What just happened
receipt.body: Every step gets stamped here as it lands. Nothing on this list is a guess.
receipt.empty: Nothing yet. Sign in and the first stamp appears.
receipt.accountDetail: Privy verified this before an account was made.
receipt.walletDetail: Created on sign in. No seed phrase, and no key Moolam holds.
receipt.passkeyDetail: The public half of this device's unlock, stored by the registry.
receipt.pinnedDetail: The signed bytes, the thumbnail and the metadata all went to IPFS.
receipt.signedDetail: Read from the contract, signed by your unlock, checked here before it was sent.
receipt.sentSponsored: Network fee paid by Moolam through Privy.
receipt.sentOwn: Network fee paid from your own balance.

passports.heading: Your passports
passports.reading: Reading everything this account has registered.
passports.unreadable: Your passports could not be read: {reason}. Reload the page.
passports.empty: Nothing registered from this account yet. The first image you register appears here within a block.

failure.serviceOffline: The Moolam verify service is not answering, so nothing was uploaded. Try again in a moment.
failure.signedOut: Your session has expired. Sign in again and the upload will work.
failure.tooLarge: That file is over the 20 MB limit. Export it smaller and try again.
failure.notAnImage: That file is not a JPEG, a PNG or a WebP image. Choose an image file.
failure.rateLimited: This account has prepared 20 images in the last hour, which is the limit. Try again later.
failure.pinFailed: The image could not be pinned to IPFS, so nothing was registered. Try again in a moment.
failure.badRequest: The verify service refused this upload. What it said is below.
failure.badResponse: The verify service answered in a shape this page does not understand, so nothing was signed. Try again.
failure.authCheck: The signature from your device would be refused by the registry, so it was not sent. Try again, and use the same unlock you bound.
failure.passkeyCancelled: The unlock prompt was closed or it timed out. Nothing was signed.
failure.passkeyOrigin: This passkey belongs to a different website, so this page cannot use it.
failure.passkeyUnsupported: This browser or device cannot make the kind of passkey the registry needs. Try a browser with fingerprint or face unlock.
failure.passkeyOther: The unlock did not finish. Your device said this:
failure.alreadyRegistered: This exact image is already registered. The first registration wins, so open the passport that holds it.
failure.expired: The hour that signature was good for has passed. Register the image again.
failure.notBound: Monad says your account has no passkey on it. Bind this device's unlock, then register the image.
failure.badSignature: The registry refused that signature. Sign again with the unlock you bound to this account.
failure.badKey: The registry refused that passkey. Bind this device's unlock again.
failure.paused: The registry is paused, so nothing can be registered right now. Try again later.
failure.wrongWallet: The image was signed for a different account than the one sending it. Reload the page and register again.
failure.rejected: The registry refused this passport. The error it gave is below.
failure.reverted: Monad refused this transaction. The error the contract gave is below.
failure.sponsorship: Privy would not pay the network fee for this transaction. What it said is below. You can send the same transaction and pay the fee yourself.
failure.sendCancelled: You closed the confirmation, so nothing was sent.
failure.sendFailed: This step did not finish. The network's own words are below. Try again in a moment.
failure.unknown: Something went wrong before anything was sent. The message is below.
failure.titleMissing: Give the picture a title first. It goes into the manifest.

actions.unsponsored: Send it and pay the fee myself

hero.lede: Moolam writes an image's exact bytes and two perceptual fingerprints into a passport the moment it is made. Recompress it, shrink it to a tenth, turn it sideways, share it twice: the copy still finds its own record.
hero.stillAlt: The registered image this passport belongs to

degrade.heading: Six ways to break it. One record.
degrade.provenance: Every figure here came from the Moolam verifier, run on passport {passport} on {date}. The crushed frames are the verifier's own output, not a filter.
